hero.label: Seasons
hero.title: A gentle constraint,
hero.description: Seven to fourteen days. Not a challenge: a light habit. Missed days break nothing.

custom.constraintPlaceholder: The constraint, in one or two sentences…

confirm.leaveBody: The season “{{title}}” will be closed. You can begin another one.

errors.constraintTooShort: Write a constraint of at least a few words.

une-dominante.title: One dominant colour
une-dominante.constraint: A single dominant colour. The others appear only in touches — or not at all.
une-dominante.invitation: Seven days to inhabit one hue. Choose it this morning — a blue, an ochre, a tired green — and let it decide the rest. The background, the silences, what you don't yet dare.

poche-a6.title: Pocket format
poche-a6.constraint: A pocket-sized support (A6, a card, an envelope, the corner of a notebook). Nothing bigger.
poche-a6.invitation: A small rectangle. No mural ambition. The gesture narrows, the time fits in your palm. Seven days of formats you could slip into a pocket.

rien-que-collage.title: Collage only
rien-que-collage.constraint: Collage only: papers, magazines, tickets, leftovers. Assembling rather than drawing.
rien-que-collage.invitation: Ten days with no compulsory pencil. You cut, you tear, you place. The composition comes from the accidents of paper — an advert, a ticket, a sky already printed.

trait-continu.title: The line that never lifts
trait-continu.constraint: One line, as continuous as possible. If it leaves the paper, that's a fresh start, not a mistake.
trait-continu.invitation: The pencil stays in contact. The line searches, hesitates, comes back. Seven days to unlearn “pretty” and find the movement again.

terres.title: Earths
terres.constraint: An earth palette: ochre, sienna, umber, cream. Little or no cool colours.
terres.invitation: A fortnight in warm browns. Soil pigments, yellowed papers, afternoon light. Time enough to settle in — then to see what remains once blue steps away.
